issues.problem: Fine-tune renders over a white background (runtime convention) whereas the official finetune.py uses black for Mip-NeRF360 (cfg_args white_background=False); sensitivity pass correctly uses black.
issues.evidence: finetune.py: bg_color = [1,1,1] if dataset.white_background else [0,0,0]; plan.md gap 2
issues.fix: Already listed as a fidelity gap; keep it in report.md. Not closable without changing the shared runtime.

issues.problem: The runtime Adam steps opacity at step 35000 (official skips the last optimizer step). The npz therefore stores opacity one Adam step (lr 0.05 on the logit) past the last rendered/observed state, quantised with the observer qparams from the previous forward. Plan.md calls this negligible; it is a legitimate extra training step but is not what the bank rendered.
issues.evidence: finetune.py: 'if iteration < max_iter: optimizer.step()'; events(): bank_step only for step < total_steps, but runtime steps all per-field optimizers
issues.fix: Optionally restore the pre-step opacity (snapshot at step 34999 end) or zero the opacity LR at step 35000 so the stored model equals the last rendered model.

issues.problem: Decoded rotation is normalize(Q(normalize(r))) while the fake-quantised model that trained/evaluated in official compress.py renders normalize(FQ(r)) (raw r). Slightly different rounding; acknowledged in plan gap 6.
issues.evidence: gaussian_model.py get_rotation = normalize(rotation_qa(_rotation)) vs save_npz quantising normalize(_rotation)
issues.fix: None needed; this mirrors the official saved file, which is the model users load.

issues.problem: The shape-sensitivity oracle is computed with the same gsplat rasterizer, so it cannot catch a symmetric-covariance gradient convention error (official CUDA backward doubles off-diagonal terms).
issues.evidence: I checked independently: finite difference of E w.r.t. each of the 6 covariance entries (symmetric perturbation) matches autograd through to_full_cov (e.g. [7328,-3882,0,4917,0,0] vs FD [7822,-3964,0,5082,0,0], fp32 noise, no factor 2 off).
issues.fix: Optionally add that finite-difference check to the probe.

issues.problem: Mini-batch sampling uses a seeded CUDA generator and index_add_ instead of CPU randint and torch_scatter; codebook init/assignments are statistically identical but not bit-identical to official.
issues.evidence: compression/vq.py uses torch.randint on CPU and scatter(reduce='sum')

summary: No critical or major issues. Checked against official compress.py, finetune.py, compression/vq.py, scene/gaussian_model.py and utils/splats.py: sensitivity (SH dc/rest + normalised covariance times eta^2, unclamped colours, black bg, per-view abs grad, pixel normalisation, quantiser call order), prune at importance>0, 4096 codebooks with beta_c 6e-7 / beta_g 3e-6 and kept vectors appended, decay 0.8, 100/800 iterations, batches 2^18/2^20, fine-tune LRs, frozen means (spatial_lr_scale=0 in official), 4999 bank optimizer steps, FakeQuantize qint8 per attribute, half positions, npz keys/dtypes, Morton sort and size all match. Steps 1-30000 reuse the baseline recipe (means LR rescaled to a 30000-step schedule, same density). paper_results.json matches the supplementary Mip360/T&T/DB tables, 3DGS rows and the garden ablation exactly. 7 unit tests pass, ss-inspect clean. Remaining items are minor and already documented.
